info.title: Evenhand API
info.description: Every action the UI takes is available here. Authenticate with a bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer …`) or the `session` cookie set by POST /api/auth/login. Errors are always `{ statusCode, error, message }`.

externalId.description: Fixture id for imported judges, e.g. jdg_24.
Fixture id (e.g. prj_01) when imported from fixtures.json.

thumbnailUrl.description: The cover image's thumbnail (the first uploaded image), or null without images.

url.description: The image, at most 1600 px on its longest side (WebP).

externalId.description: Fixture id (e.g. prj_01) when imported from fixtures.json.

thumbnailUrl.description: The cover image's thumbnail (the first uploaded image), or null without images.

answers.description: Answers to the event's public questions, in question order. Private answers never appear.

question.description: The question's id (or the id it was imported under).

value.description: The answer; `null` or blank text clears it.

summary.description: One-paragraph summary shown on gallery cards.

description.description: Long description (Markdown is rendered as plain text for now).

track.description: Track id or fixture id (e.g. trk_01).

answers.description: Answers to the event's custom questions. Questions left out keep their answer.

externalId.description: Fixture id (e.g. prj_01) when imported from fixtures.json.

answers.description: Its answers to the event's custom questions, in question order; unanswered ones are absent.

status.description: DRAFT until a member submits it; SUBMITTED entries appear in the public gallery.

eligibility.description: DISQUALIFIED by the organisers: out of the gallery, judging and rankings.

disqualifyReason.description: The organisers' reason; null unless disqualified.

supersededById.description: The team's newer entry that replaced this one as a confirmed duplicate, if any.

duplicateHold.description: The older copy of a suspected duplicate, waiting for the organisers' decision.

track.description: Track id or fixture id (e.g. trk_01) of this event; `null` for no track.

answers.description: Answers to the event's custom questions. Questions left out keep their answer.

id.description: Internal judge id (the judge's EventRole id).

superseded.description: True when the review belonged to a merged duplicate; excluded from ranking.

values.description: Raw criterion values keyed by criterion key.

weightedScore.description: Weighted score on the criterion scale; null while the review is incomplete.

share.description: weight / sum of weights, e.g. 0.5 for half of the score.

locked.description:
True once any review is final: criteria can then no longer be added or removed and ranges
cannot change (existing scores would stop fitting). Labels and weights stay editable.

key.description: Stable machine name, e.g. `functionality`. Derived from the label when omitted.

weight.description: Relative weight: shares are weight / sum of weights.

seed.description: Seed for the random tie-breaks, to reproduce a run. A fresh one is drawn when omitted.

total.description: Assigned in total, across all runs.

have.description: Reviews it has after the run.

eligibleJudges.description: Judges who could review it at all (covering its track, without a conflict).

projects.description: Projects in judging: submitted, eligible, not a replaced or held duplicate copy.

components.description:
Connected groups of judges who share projects. Above 1, some judges' leniency cannot be
compared with the others'.

position.description: Position in this judge's queue for the event, from 0.

judgingOpen.description: False once judging has closed: reviews can then no longer change.

answers.description: The team's answers to the event's questions, private ones included, in question order.

share.description: Share of the score, weight / sum of weights.

position.description: Place in the queue from 0; -1 when the project is no longer in judging.

queueLength.description: Assignments in this judge's queue for the event (projects still in judging).

inJudging.description:
False once the project was disqualified or replaced by a newer copy: the review can be
read but not changed (409 `not_in_judging`).

weightedScore.description: Weighted score once every criterion is marked, else null.

values.description:
Marks by criterion key. A draft may leave some out (or send null to clear one); each mark
must be a whole number inside its criterion's range.

judgesNotStarted.description: Judges with work assigned who have not saved anything yet.

projectsUnreviewed.description: Projects with no finished review yet.

externalId.description: Fixture id (e.g. jdg_07) for judges imported from fixtures.json.

lastActivity.description: When they last saved or submitted anything; null if they have not started.

flat.description:
Gave every project exactly the same marks across 3+ final reviews: their marks say nothing
about how projects differ. (Different marks that average out equal are not flagged.)

externalId.description: Fixture id (e.g. evt_01) when imported from fixtures.json.

submissionsOpen.description: True while the server accepts submissions: opensAt <= now < submissionsClose.

slug.description: URL name, e.g. `spring-hack-2026`. Derived from the name when omitted.

opensAt.description: When submissions open. Optional: without it, submissions are open until the close.

submissionsClose.description: Submissions are accepted only while now < submissionsClose (server clock, UTC).

judgingClose.description: When judging ends. Must be after submissionsClose.

externalId.description: Fixture id (e.g. evt_01) when imported from fixtures.json.

submissionsOpen.description: True while the server accepts submissions: opensAt <= now < submissionsClose.

track.description: The track this prize is for (id or fixture id, e.g. trk_01). Omit for an overall prize.

externalId.description: The id it was imported under, if any.

id.description: The question this row keeps (its id, or the id it was imported under). Omit for a new one.

prompt.description: What the team is asked; unique within the event.

required.description: A draft can leave it empty; submitting needs an answer. Default false.

isPublic.description: Answers are shown in the public gallery. Default false: team, organisers and judges only.

since.description: When they became an organiser of this event.

email.description: An existing account's email: the portal sends no email, so they register first.

externalId.description: Fixture id (e.g. tm_01) when imported from fixtures.json.

submissionId.description: The team's current submission in this event (draft or submitted), if it has one.

submissionsOpen.description: True while the event accepts submissions and team changes.

submission.description: The team's current submission, if it has started one.

token.description: The secret. Shown only in this response; the server keeps a hash.

path.description: Path to share, relative to the portal, e.g. /invites/<token>.

intact.description: True when every entry's hash matches its content, every link holds, and the chain ends at the recorded head.

linked.description: Entries reached by walking the chain from the first one. Fewer than `entries` means a gap.

head.description: The hash of the newest entry, as recorded by the database. Note it down to detect later truncation.

headMatches.description: False when the walk ends somewhere other than the recorded head (newest entries removed).

altered.description: Ids of entries whose content no longer matches their hash (edited). Admins only; empty for organisers.

broken.description: Ids of entries whose predecessor is missing (something before them was deleted). Admins only.

alteredCount.description: Counts of the two lists above, for everyone.

id.description: Increasing: a later entry always has a larger id.

actor.description: Who did it; null for the system (seed, command line).

target.description: The target's name or title, when it can be resolved (also for deleted rows).

summary.description: One readable sentence, e.g. `Ben joined the team "Quiet Hours" with an invite link`.

id.description: Increasing: a later entry always has a larger id.

actor.description: Who did it; null for the system (seed, command line).

target.description: The target's name or title, when it can be resolved (also for deleted rows).

summary.description: One readable sentence, e.g. `Ben joined the team "Quiet Hours" with an invite link`.

tracks.description: Tracks the judge will cover (ids or fixture ids). Required when the event has tracks.

maxUses.description: How many people can accept it: 1 for one person (default), more for a panel link.

token.description: The secret. Shown only in this response; the server keeps a hash.

judgeId.description: The judge's id in this event (their event role).

externalId.description: Fixture id (e.g. jdg_24) for judges imported from fixtures.json.

assigned.description: Projects assigned to them, and how many of those they have finished.

rank.description: 1… for ranked projects; null when there is too little evidence to rank it.

tieGroup.description: Projects in one group cannot be told apart by the data; null when not ranked.

move.description: Rank by raw mean minus rank by normalized score (positive: moved up).

reason.description: Why the normalized score differs from the raw mean, in one line.

held.description: The older entry. While held (same team), it is out of judging and its reviews are not ranked.

heldOutReviews.description: Final reviews of the older entry that this run could not use.

reviews.description: Final reviews that scored an earlier version.

atEdge.description: The chosen λ sits on the edge of the searched grid.

meanOnlyLooMse.description: Leave-one-out error of predicting every review by the mean of the others.

unreviewed.description: Projects in judging with no final review; not in the ranking.

pendingDuplicates.description:
Duplicates not yet decided when the run was made. A run can be computed with some pending,
but not published (409 `duplicates_pending`): decide them on the entries page first.
Absent on runs made before this was recorded.

changedAfterReview.description:
Projects whose team changed them after some of their final reviews were submitted: those
judges scored an earlier version. Shown, not blocking. Absent on older runs.

inputsHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical inputs (reviews and weights) and of the canonical result.

current.description: False once the event's final reviews or weights have changed since this run.

inputsHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical inputs (reviews and weights) and of the canonical result.

current.description: False once the event's final reviews or weights have changed since this run.

inputsHash.description: Anyone can recompute these from the exported data to check the published result.

auditHead.description:
The audit chain's head when these results were published: anyone can note it down.
Null for results published before anchoring existed.

auditHeadInLog.description:
Checked now: is that hash still in the audit log? False means history was rewritten after
publication. Null when there is no anchor.

externalId.description: Fixture id (e.g. prj_07) when imported from fixtures.json.

disqualifyReason.description: Why it was disqualified; null unless disqualified.

finalReviews.description: Final reviews that count (reviews set aside by a duplicate merge are not counted).

changedAfterReview.description:
Of those, how many scored an earlier version: the team changed the entry after the judge
submitted (allowed until the deadline). 0 for reviews imported from fixtures.json.

moved.description: Judges who reviewed only the older copy: their reviews move to the kept entry.

setAside.description: Judges who reviewed both copies: their review of the older copy no longer counts.

reason.description: SAME_TEAM: one team submitted twice. SAME_REPO / SAME_TITLE: two teams, one project?

kept.description: The newer copy, kept when the duplicate is confirmed.

superseded.description: The older copy, replaced when the duplicate is confirmed.

merge.description: Pending: what confirming would do. Confirmed: what it did. Dismissed: nothing.

blockedBy.description: Confirming or dismissing this is refused, and why (null when it is allowed).

reason.description: Shown to the team and recorded in the audit trail.

order.description: Every image id of the submission, in the new order; the first becomes the cover.

name.description: The author's display name. Their email is never shown with a comment.

hidden.description: True only in an organiser's view: visitors never receive hidden comments.

hideReason.description: The organiser's reason, in an organiser's view of a hidden comment; otherwise null.

body.description: 1 to 2,000 characters; shown as plain text.

reason.description: Why it is hidden: recorded in the audit trail and shown to the event's organisers.

open.description: True while votes are counted (server clock).

closed.description: True once the window has passed: results can be published.

hasLink.description: OPEN_LINK: whether a shared link exists (its secret is shown only when it is made).

repeatVotes.description: Of `votes`, those from ballots taken by an address that took more than one (shared link).

round.description: Null until the organisers set up a vote.

passes.description: Personal voting links made so far (email list and open link).

repeatAddresses.description: Shared link: addresses that took more than one ballot. The addresses are not shown.

repeatBallots.description: Shared link: the ballots those addresses took.

tallies.description: Every project in the vote, most votes first. Organisers only until results are published.

mode.description:
Who may vote: ACCOUNTS (anyone logged in), EMAIL_LIST (a personal link per listed email)
or OPEN_LINK (a shared link that hands each visitor a personal link).

opensAt.description: When votes start counting (ISO 8601 with a time zone).

closesAt.description: When votes stop counting; after opensAt.

votesPerVoter.description: How many different projects one voter may vote for (1 to 10).

emails.description: The voters' emails; each gets one personal voting link.

token.description: The secret for this voter's link, /vote/<token>. Shown once; only its hash is stored.

skipped.description: Emails that already had a link (their link is unchanged) or are not email addresses.

token.description: The shared link's secret, /vote/link/<token>. Shown once; making a new one retires it.

voted.description: This ballot has a vote for it.

own.description: The voter is on this project's team, so cannot vote for it.

closed.description: True once the window has passed.

projects.description: In this ballot's own random order, the same every time it is opened.

project.description: The project: its id or fixture id.

open.description: True while votes are counted (server clock).

resultsPublished.description: The results page has something to show.
